description.value: PappaRoti is a Vancouver outpost of a Malaysian-origin cafe chain celebrated for its signature coffee-caramel buns — a soft, buttery roti with a crisp coffee crust born from a family recipe in Malaysia around 2000. Situated on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, it sits close to the Stanley Park seawall cycling corridor. The cafe offers both indoor and outdoor seating and has grown to multiple BC locations.
